newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT-Electricity Gen rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Electricity Gen rated buy.

text.p: Asia Equity Ltd recommended on Friday that investors buy Thai private power producer Electricity Generating Plc (EGCO) stocks because of its guaranteed revenues.

"One hundred percent of EGCO's electricity capacity will be purchased at preset prices for the next 20 years, EGCO's revenue are not only predictable, but essentially guaranteed. No other listed company can offer such assurance," Asia Equity said in a research report.
Asia Equity said EGCO's share price had fallen by one third over the past three weeks on concerns about the company's foreign currency exposure. The sell-off was over done, it added.
Electricity Generating was steady at 52.50 baht on Friday.

"EGCO's current share price...is clearly supported by fundamental value. Given the company's strategic positioning for future projects inside and outside of Thailand, we believe it is a steal at this price," Asia Equity said.
